answer: Anyone running 157 aliases therefore needs 197 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in trellis, expire in kernel, and lagoon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1844 identities would post 2301 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
